QUOTE: "a contributor adds a code by editing the module header and regenerating, not by hand-editing `error.c`." and "Add `#define MBEDTLS_ERR_<MOD>_<NAME> -0x00XX` in that module's header, with exactly one Doxygen description" and "Do not edit the auto-generated section of `library/error.c` by hand."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that a new error string is added by a documented #define in the module header followed by regeneration, and that error.c is not hand-edited.
